## **In the matter of** 

Petition under Sections 79(1)(c) and 79(1)(f) of the Electricity Act, 2003 (“Act”), challenging the regulation of open access and consequent curtailment of power from Petitioner’s 300 MW generation project.

## **ORDER** 

The Petitioner, Ambuja Cements Limited, has filed the present Petition with the following prayers: 

“(a) _Hold that Ambuja Cements/ Petitioner as a generator in the Essel Solar Park is not liable to any consequences on account of non-payment of CTUIL bills by Essel Saurya._ 

_(b) Direct Respondent No. 2 to not regulate access and not curtail Ambuja Cements generation on account of any default in payments by Essel Saurya._ 

_(c) In the interim, direct immediate restoration of Ambuja Cements’ access to the ISTS and ensure that no regulation of access or curtailment of Ambuja Cements’ generation is affected on account of such non-payment._ 

_(d) Pass such further orders and directions as this Commission may deem fit in the facts and circumstances of the present case.”_ 

2. The Petition was listed for admission on 3.6.2026. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the Petitioner is a solar power generator located within a solar park and had filed the present Petition along with the IA in March 2026, aggrieved by the restriction of its access to the Inter-State Transmission System (ISTS) on account of the regulation of power under the applicable Late Payment Surcharge (LPS) framework. She further submitted that, subsequent to the filing of the instant Petition, the requisite payment has been made under compelling circumstances and, consequently, the Petitioner’s access to the ISTS has been restored. In view of the subsequent developments, the learned counsel sought permission to withdraw the present Petition with liberty to approach the Commission on a similar issue, if required. 

3. Considering the submissions made by the Petitioner, the Petitioner is permitted to withdraw the present Petition with the liberty to approach the Commission, if required, in accordance with the law. Accordingly, the present Petition is disposed of as withdrawn.
